cells.tense: You are here, and the direction you set from vision is holding.
cells.act: share your strength where it is needed
cells.ask: Pick someone close by who is short of something you have plenty of. Give one piece of help this week that finishes. Hand it over and stop. Don't check in about it after.
cells.core:
You pick a heading from what you believe in, and right now that heading is holding. In company, the people near you get a course, not just a take. They can tell the difference between a direction you chose from vision and one you echoed, and you are inside that difference day to day.

The habit worth keeping is smaller than it sounds. Share your strength where it is needed. When someone in reach is short of what you have plenty of, give one piece of it — help that ends this week, not help that opens a role for you. You will feel the pull to overshoot. The alignment is in the match, not in the amount. What you hand over belongs in their hands after.

cells.tense: You are bracing for a turn that has not happened yet.
cells.act: hold many truths at once without collapsing them
cells.ask: Take the next week keeping every direction that pulls on you unhurried and unchosen. Name them to yourself as they arrive. Let the pulled ones stand beside each other until one of them starts to look like yours.
cells.core:
You know which light to move toward — that is the gift, and it is real. Lately it runs past the moment. Among people, this looks like arguing for a heading before the other person has said where they stand. You listen for agreement instead of listening for them. The pull is fast and it feels like clarity.

Hold many truths at once without collapsing them. Every direction pulling on you can stand beside the others for now, exactly as many as there are, no ranking. Somewhere in that set is a pull you picked up from someone else and have been steering by. You will not need to argue with it once you see it.

cells.tense: You are still standing at a door that has already opened.
cells.act: rest in the result of the tending
cells.ask: Choose one thing that grew because of you — a room, a craft, a body, a person — and sit with it for ten minutes with nothing to fix. Notice it is grown. Then get up.
cells.core:
The direction was real. You set it and it held — something in your life is where it is because of what you chose to do. You keep not arriving at it. Among people, that shows up as talking about the next leg while someone is asking about this one, and it costs you the room you are already in.

Rest in what your care produced. Ten minutes on one growing thing, no notes — a room, a body, a craft, a person. Let it be grown without you improving it. The pull is to reach for the next mountain, and that pull can wait its turn. What you made is here and finished. Enjoyment is what closes the loop.

cells.tense: You are steering people on a heading they believe they found alone.
cells.act: give a concrete piece of help and finish it
cells.ask: Pick one person whose direction you helped set. Do a single finished thing for them this week — something that closes. No report after. Let the finishing be the whole acknowledgment, then walk out of it. It is theirs from there.
cells.core:
Someone's direction got set by you — a choice made from vision, in your voice, when they needed to hear it. Asked, you would describe it as being nearby and saying what you saw. The heading is holding, and it is holding you as well. Being its unlisted keeper is the part you do not say.

Give a concrete piece of help and finish it, once. A closed thing, no follow-up, no explanation of why you did it. You are subtracting yourself from a role you did not name. The help speaks and you do not have to. Afterward it is theirs again, and the direction goes on without you carrying it.
cells.sheetLine: The heading is theirs, and you are holding it.
